name: @staydesk/worker
description: StayDesk background jobs: outbox dispatch, hold expiry, reconciliation, notifications.

scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && concurrently -k -n tsc,worker "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env --watch-path=dist dist/main.js"
